findings: LAW 6d (constructible escape routes / cardboard): engine does NOT support placement-as-wall. Placed cardboard blocks PAINT only — never movement, sight, or grenades; it is a 10-HP destructible, crushed by walking into it, a finite per-team pickup (barrierPickups config, cap 2), runtime-only (not in map spec, not in art render). Cited: sim.nim:1507-1570/594-666/1897-1934, sim_types.nim:1502-1517/588-612. So 6d socket-structures are NOT built (the 6d order's own STOP condition: do not fake it with static geometry).

LAW 11b full vocabulary: the only MAP-PLACED item is the medkit (point). Barrier + perks are per-team config, not composer-placeable. v5 uses medkit clusters (stash) vs singles (bribes); a richer placeable-item vocabulary is an engine-side change, flagged not faked.

ENGINE-SYMMETRY (v5 root cause of the v4 gate FAIL): `leftObstacles` is CONTRACTUALLY the LEFT half (arena.nim reference map + comments 'x-mirrored like every column-1 shape'); the engine ALWAYS mirror-images it (buildArenaObstacles, default symMirror) — there is NO independent-halves mode. mesa.py through v4 drew BOTH keeps explicitly, so the mirror of the blue keep's solid wall landed on the red keep and sealed its asymmetric ramp/crevice (only the ~mirror-symmetric crest survived). v5 emits the LEFT half only; the engine builds blue as red's mirror. CONSEQUENCE: the keeps are now MIRROR-SYMMETRIC, not the hand-authored function-balanced non-mirror keeps of c93881 — this is a DESIGN FORK for Maxwell (mirror is standard + function-correct for sides-CTF: both open fieldward). Also GENERALIZATION-CRITICAL (c96665): every composer map must respect the left-half contract or it silently double-seals.
designManifest.symmetry: mirror (leftObstacles = left half; blue = engine mirror of red)
